violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. Person in charge ordered test kit during inspection.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The facility has not posted the 2025 permit at the facility at the time of inspection, the 2024 permit placed in a glass frame has been placed behind the wooden tray with styrofoam cups, and other single use items where it is not visible .
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTIVE ACTION: Post the 2025 Health Department Permit in conspicuous location within 10 days. Contact the Health Department if a duplicate permit is needed. A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.
